title: Fill
description: Paint insides: switch fill on, choose a solid colour or a two-colour gradient, and repaint a selection's fill.

bubble.title: The Fill section
bubble.body: The Fill section paints insides: one flat colour, or a gradient that blends two colours. Like Stroke, it sets the next shape's fill and repaints a selection's.

bubble.title: Watch: draw with a gradient
bubble.body: Press Watch demo: the program switches fill on, sets a linear gradient, and draws a rectangle wearing it.

demo.title: Clearing the selection
demo.body: Escape first, so the fill settings land on the next shape drawn.

demo.title: Drawing with it
demo.body: Fill on: a blue-to-orange linear gradient. Drawing a rectangle with I.

demo.title: Done
demo.body: The rectangle lands wearing the gradient.

bubble.title: Switch to solid
bubble.body: Press Escape to deselect the demo's rectangle. Then switch the Fill Type to Solid — with nothing selected, the section sets the fill the next shape will wear.

bubble.title: Draw with your fill
bubble.body: Steer to a corner and press I to start a rectangle. Fill is on, and solid.

bubble.title: Finish the rectangle
bubble.body: Steer to the opposite corner and press I again. This rectangle lands with a flat, solid fill.

bubble.title: Repaint it as a gradient
bubble.body: Your rectangle is still selected. Switch its Type to Linear gradient — only the selection repaints. The next shape you draw would still land solid.

bubble.title: Solid or gradient
bubble.body: Set the fill before you draw, or repaint a selection afterwards. Type picks solid or gradient; the two colours are a gradient's ends.
